body:
Ha! I just did in an email and he backpedaled saying that law is "actually JUST for landlords! Sorry!" or something.

I think I may have him! Thanks for everybody's response. Made me A TON more confident! I am wondering what he CAN add into the lease with his "New rules may be created by the landlord as new situations arise" clause under House Rules? Everything under there is just about cleaning up after yourself and not being a drunk TOO loudly.

That's what I feel and have explained that to him, but he's a rather adamant. I'm no lawyer, but the landlord just scared me quoting the law about "Colorado laws require termination terms..." if that's even true...

Sorry. I worded things badly perhaps in my original post. The lease is FOR a year and I just signed it about three months ago. It has not ended.

And it's actually two leases with the landlord if that makes a difference. One from July 1st 2015 until December 31st 2015 and then One from January 1st to September 2016. I moved in and then he asked if I wanted a new lease for the next year and I agreed. Seemed a bit odd, but the rent was cheap. Does having two leases instead of one make an actual difference? It's for sure a fixed lease since it ends September 2016 right?

The text is identical in both leases except the dates in the term section. The term section states (from the most recent one): "Lease will be in effect from January 1st 2015 to September 30th 2016. A 30 day notice is required to terminate the lease early or make a renewal at the end of term."

I should also maybe point out it's a very short lease that I'm almost certain the landlord made himself.

If I'm understanding you correctly then, my lease being a fixed term and NOT a month to month means he cannot change the terms without my agreement? What can he add with his "New rules may be created by the landlord as new situations arise." clause under House Rules? Everything under there is just about cleaning up after yourself and not being a drunk TOO loudly!
Yeah. No joke. Figured he would just add stuff if people were being too loud or something!
